verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates third-party coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in parallel workspaces, but the evidence never documents Conductor itself mapping, indexing, or explaining a codebase, or gathering context automatically. Any such ability would belong to the underlying agents, a host capability that earns no credit. The ⌘⇧F file-content search is a manual, user-driven feature and only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can have the agent map and explain an entire unfamiliar codebase without manually selecting context files
